'''Kog''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the first mate of [[Hura Kogler]] during an operation to place infiltration [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].
